body:
at dusk: the crop trial crew brought sealed seed packet. my brother started coughing. I washed everything twice before the siren began.

The mark was made in a hurry, before the queue moved. I checked it twice against the people standing with me.

When I returned, the window was closed and the board was blank. I kept the page because it was the only one with our address.
title: At dusk: sealed seed packet
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.
